UBAIDUL HAQUE 
Regulatory Reporting & Payments| FX & Treasury Settlements 
Bangalore, India  |  +91 9611898552  |  Ubaidhaque001@gmail.com 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Business Execution professional with 9+ years in financial services, specializing in regulatory reporting (EMIR, MiFID II, CA SS), 
payments, and FX/treasury settlements across capital markets. Proven track record leading EMIR trade and collateral reporting , 
MiFID II transaction reporting, and cross-jurisdiction back-reporting on Colline, while driving ISO 20022 (MX) migration and SWIFT 
messaging (MT202, MT303, MT900/910, MT940/950, MT540, MT599) standards adoption. Delivered $1.4M in cost savings and 
2,600+ hours saved annually through Alteryx automation, with hands -on expertise executing FX spot settlements, clearing payment 
exceptions within strict cut-off windows, and leading teams through client account transfers, cash payments, and funding across the 
full trade and payment lifecycle. 
AREAS OF EXPERTISE 
Regulatory Reporting 
• Lead EMIR trade and collateral reporting, MiFID II transaction reporting, and cross -jurisdiction back-reporting, validating data 
quality to meet regulatory deadlines and audit standards. 
• Perform CASS client money and custody asset reconciliations, and maintain CASS, REMS, and RCSA operational risk frameworks 
to prevent AML/ASL breaches. 
• Partner with Technology, Legal, Compliance, and Risk teams to investigate and remediate reporting breaks across Colline and 
downstream regulatory reporting platforms. 
Payments 
• Lead a team accountable for client account transfers, cash payments, and funding across the full trade and payment lifecycle for 
a high-volume securities function. 
• Own workflow tracking, queue management, and exception management, resolving escalated, time -sensitive payment issues 
against strict cut-off timelines. 
• Delivered daily overdraft (OD) position reporting on client accounts, ensuring SLA/KRI payment commitments were met, and 
reported $1M+ overdraft positions across APAC. 
ISO 20022 & SWIFT Messaging 
• Drove ISO 20022 (MX) adoption initiatives alongside Alteryx automation, saving 2,600+ hours annually and improving 
nostro/trade reconciliation accuracy. 
• Completed internal training on ISO 20022 (MX) Messaging Standards and SWIFT Payment Processing at JP Morgan Chase & Co.  
• Working knowledge of SWIFT MT202, MT303, MT900/910, MT940/950, MT540, and MT599 message types across payment, 
treasury, and settlement workflows. 
FX & Treasury 
• Executed FX settlements — buying and selling currencies at spot rate per client instructions — within currency cut-off windows, 
clearing cash exceptions on TLM and ELM. 
• Funded corporate action events and corrected client books through FX adjustments arising from internal or market -driven 
settlement errors. 
• Use Colline for Initial Margin (IM) and Variation Margin (VM) collateral management, supporting regulatory reporting aligned 
with EMIR margin and collateral obligations. 
Institutional Client Onboarding 
• Coordinate across Front Office, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Credit, Documentation, Collateral, and Client Account teams to  
ensure all prerequisites are completed prior to trading commencement.  
• Track KYC/AML documentation, credit approvals, and account set -up requirements end-to-end, escalating outstanding items to 
keep onboarding timelines on track. 
• Act as the central point of contact between internal stakeholders and clients, resolving onboarding blockers to accelerate 
account activation and trade readiness. 
CORE SKILLS 
Trade & Capital Markets: Securities & trade lifecycle, client onboarding, custodial & settlement operations, GL reconciliation (Nostro, 
Trade, Receivables), Letters of Credit, sanctions screening 
Platforms: Colline (Initial & Variation Margin), TLM, ELM, GXM, WCM, ExcApp, CCREM, SAP, SDAC, AMS  
Analytics & Automation: Alteryx automation, Power BI, Tableau, Advanced Excel, MIS reporting  
Leadership: Team leadership & coaching, workflow & queue management, cross -functional collaboration, process improvement 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Execution Lead – Regulatory Reporting, Payments & Reconciliation 2022 – Present 
JP Morgan Chase & Co., Bangalore 
• Lead a team accountable for client account transfers, cash payments, and FX funding across the full trade and payment lifecyc le, 
ensuring accurate, timely settlement for a high-volume securities function. 
• Support EMIR trade and collateral reporting, MiFID II transaction reporting, and cross -jurisdiction back-reporting of trades and 
positions, validating data quality to meet regulatory deadlines and audit standards.  
• Partner with Technology, Legal, Compliance, and Risk teams to investigate and remediate reporting breaks and discrepancies 
across Colline and downstream regulatory reporting platforms. 
• Partner with Client Services, Sales, Product, and Finance leadership to resolve cross -functional settlement and reporting issues 
and deliver measurable client outcomes. 
Senior Financial Analyst – Regulatory Reporting, Payments & Reconciliation 2015 – 2022 
Northern Trust, Bangalore 
• Performed CASS client money and custody asset reconciliations and EMIR trade/collateral reporting checks, investigating

• Operated within a real-time back-end settlement processing team, ensuring daily payment instructions from investment

• Funded corporate action events and corrected client books through FX adjustments arising from internal or market -driven 
settlement errors. 
• Processed and approved foreign exchange deals and cash settlements, including repatriation of non -trade transactions to base

• Reviewed, audited, and monitored cash and payment transactions — trades, income, corporate actions, redemptions, journals, 
fees, and overdrafts — across global client accounts, in line with Investment Manager Account Profile (IMAP) instructions.  
• Generated and distributed Daily, Weekly, and Monthly volume reports, ERM summaries, and OD reports within scheduled

Intern – Trade Finance Jan 2015 – Jul 2015 
Deutsche Bank, Bangalore 
• Supported Letters of Credit, import/export bill booking, and discrepancy handling for Hong Kong and Singapore branches; 
performed first-check sanctions screening, Hot Scan, and Embargo filtering.  
• Prepared applicant notification messages and coordinated with dual -check teams to ensure documentation accuracy ahead of 
regulatory and compliance review. 
KEY PROJECTS & IMPACT 
• $1.4M in cost savings delivered via CSD charges optimization through detailed reconciliation analysis.  
• 2,600+ hours saved annually via Alteryx automation across reconciliation, payments, and regulatory reporting workflows, 
improving data quality and turnaround time in settlement processes.  
• Regulatory reporting quality initiative: strengthened CASS client money reconciliation and EMIR trade/collateral reporting 
controls, reducing unresolved regulatory breaks and improving audit readiness.
